verdict.rationale: Cline's homepage says you can chat with the agent from Slack or Linear and run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions or GitLab pipelines. The CLI docs back up the headless automation path with examples such as auto-approved task commands. All four named surfaces are covered, but the support rests on one marketing line. For GitHub and GitLab, tasks are started through CI pipelines rather than a native issue or PR trigger. Missing for 10: dedicated setup docs for the Slack and Linear integrations, native GitHub/GitLab issue or PR mention triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
